title: Replace app logo with user-provided VoiceMate logo image

requirements.summary: Replace the current app logo with the user-provided VoiceMate logo image throughout the application
acceptanceCriteria: The uploaded VoiceMate logo image replaces the existing logo in the landing page hero section
The uploaded VoiceMate logo image replaces the existing logo in the AppLayout header
Logo image is properly sized and styled to fit the existing layout design
Logo image displays correctly in both light and dark themes

file_operations.description: Replace the existing logo in the hero section with an img element that references the generated VoiceMate logo at frontend/public/assets/generated/voicemate-logo.dim_800x800.png. Ensure the image is properly sized and styled to fit the hero section layout, with appropriate alt text for accessibility. Apply styles that ensure the logo displays correctly in both light and dark themes.

Replace the existing logo in the header branding section with an img element that references the generated VoiceMate logo at frontend/public/assets/generated/voicemate-logo.dim_800x800.png. Size the logo appropriately for the header (smaller than the hero version), ensure it maintains aspect ratio, and add appropriate alt text. Apply styles that ensure the logo displays correctly in both light and dark themes, maintaining visual consistency with the existing header design.

requirements.summary: Render the generated logo image as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated without routing through the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Logo image is served from frontend/public/assets/generated directory
Logo image loads correctly on initial page render
No backend endpoints are used for serving the logo image

file_operations.description: Verify that the logo image src attribute uses the correct static asset path /assets/generated/voicemate-logo.dim_800x800.png (which maps to frontend/public/assets/generated/voicemate-logo.dim_800x800.png at build time). Ensure no HTTP calls or backend actor methods are used to fetch the logo image.

Verify that the logo image src attribute uses the correct static asset path /assets/generated/voicemate-logo.dim_800x800.png (which maps to frontend/public/assets/generated/voicemate-logo.dim_800x800.png at build time). Ensure no HTTP calls or backend actor methods are used to fetch the logo image, and that it loads correctly on initial page render.
